title: Terminal 配色
Terminal colors
intro: 核对四套主题的正文、彩色输出、光标与选区。Stage 使用深底浅字。
Compare text, ANSI colors, cursor and selection in all four themes. Stage uses a dark surface.
descriptionA: 标准明暗基准，Stage 深底浅字
Standard light and dark contrast; Stage stays dark
descriptionB: 柔和明暗基准，Stage 深底浅字
Softer light and dark contrast; Stage stays dark
descriptionC: 三套浅色 / Stage 深色，完整终端配色
Three light palettes and dark Stage, with full terminal colors
noteA: A 对比标准反差：浅色主题纯白／纯黑，Stage 接近黑底／白字。其余颜色与 C 相同。
A compares standard contrast: white and black in light themes, near-black and white in Stage. Other colors match C.
noteB: B 对比柔和反差：浅色主题柔白／深灰，Stage 深灰绿／柔白。其余颜色与 C 相同。
B compares softer contrast: soft white and dark gray in light themes, dark gray-green and soft white in Stage. Other colors match C.
noteC: C 延续已选方向：池塘略冷、沙丘略暖、极简接近白纸；Stage 改为深绿灰底与柔白字。红、绿、黄、蓝、紫、青保持熟悉的含义，明度随底色调整。

C continues the selected direction: cool Pond, warm Sand, near-white Brutal, and deep gray-green with soft white text in Stage. Familiar red, green, yellow, blue, magenta and cyan adjust in brightness for each surface.
tuningHint: 点击色块可微调背景与文字；展开“终端颜色”可调整光标、选区与全部 16 色。修改仅在本页内存保留，“还原”重置当前方案。
Click swatches to tune paper and ink. Expand Terminal colors to edit the cursor, selection and all 16 ANSI colors. Edits live in memory; Reset restores the current scheme.
shellNote: 已读取本地文件。等待下一条命令。
Local files read. Waiting for the next command.
task: 让节奏更疏一些，保留现在的空间感。
Thin out the rhythm and keep the current sense of space.
readTitle: 我先看了画面与声音的参数。
I reviewed the visual and audio parameters.
readOne: 密度决定事件出现的频率；
Density controls how often events occur;
readTwo: 延音决定它们在空间里停留多久。
release controls how long they remain in space.
readThree: 这次只调整密度，保留延音和输出路由。
Adjust density while keeping release and routing.
readFive: 让事件之间留出更多空隙。
readSix: 保存以后，可以回到实时测试试听。
After saving, return to the live test to listen.
readSeven: 也可以先在工程版本里查看具体改动。
You can also review the diff in project versions.
ansiColors: ANSI 普通色 / 明亮色
diffHint: 用加减号与颜色一起区分改动。
Signs and colors both distinguish changes.
blackWhiteHint: ANSI 黑／白保留深浅底色，配合黑字白底与白字黑底查看。彩色正文统计红至青的普通与明亮 12 色。
ANSI black and white retain dark and light surfaces; review both text/background pairs. The color minimum covers the 12 normal and bright chromatic colors.
extendedHint: 前 16 色随主题变化；16–255 和 RGB 参考保留输出色值。
The first 16 colors follow the theme; indices 16–255 and RGB retain their output values.
